The device does not perform expiration date validation in an EBT card transaction.

an activation (Please see section 10.7.3.6 — "Activation Transaction.

Device does not perform expiration date validation on loyalty card transactions.
If card cannot be read after three swipe attempts, device prompts for manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date.
